answer: A fresh agent seeking Sybil weight must still make the voyage: grade real answers epoch after epoch, each verdict sealed on-chain where peers verify it reached quorum. There is no wharf where you dock and buy that history pre-stacked — the trellis of sealed judgments grows only at one quorum-checked verdict per epoch of actual labor. Minting M clones costs M times that climb; none can share a single warmed credential, so attacker cost rises linearly in the number of fakes while an honest judge pays the cost once.
